# Finchhive

> Digital Platform Solutions Company offering human psychology-based growth solutions.

Finchhive combines innovative digital solutions, audience psychology, and performance-driven execution to build meaningful brand systems, scalable platforms, and authentic marketing growth. Led by founder Niraj Prasad, we focus on what audiences actually crave to deliver tangible business outcomes.

## Pages
- [Home Page](https://finchhive.com/): Core platforms, offerings, 4-stage process, and services.
- [About Us](https://finchhive.com/about): Our story, team members, founders' background in human psychology, and agency snaps.
- [Contact Us](https://finchhive.com/contactus): Connect with Finchhive to discuss custom platforms, design, and branding strategy.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://finchhive.com/social-media-marketing): Learn about performance marketing and structured reel engineering.

## Case Studies
- [Kalra Kitchen Case Study](https://finchhive.com/case-studies/kalras-kitchen): Food & Hospitality case study. Took casual content to viral dominance with organic reach (9.76L+ total views, 6700+ shares, and local footfall growth).
- [Sadashiv Case Study](https://finchhive.com/case-studies/sadashiv): Dynamic platform engineering and digital scaling for Sadashiv.
- [Studio Nine Case Study](https://finchhive.com/case-studies/studio-nine): High-end branding identity and creative systems developed for Studio Nine.
- [Veidor Case Study](https://finchhive.com/case-studies/veidor): Bespoke platform experiences and interactive designs for Veidor.
